entries.reason: Authoritative certified-seed plan completion with exact input, output, facility and order identities.
entries.integration_reason: The exact receipt participates in the outcome-aware physical output transaction before the order advances to OutputPublished, then the owner acknowledges and finalizes it.

entries.reason: Command/request transport signal; it does not assert that burden reduction completed.
entries.integration_reason: The medical/treatment terminal operation and persisted deprivation aggregate own the resulting state transition.
entries.replacement_authority: CharacterMedicalRuntime terminal treatment result plus CharacterDeprivationRuntime persisted infection-burden state

entries.reason: Command/request transport signal; it does not assert that infection burden was applied.
entries.integration_reason: The originating medical operation and persisted deprivation aggregate own the resulting state transition.
entries.replacement_authority: CharacterMedicalRuntime terminal medical result plus CharacterDeprivationRuntime persisted infection-burden state

entries.reason: Prepared ecology subresult of one crop harvest, not a separate terminal operation.
entries.integration_reason: The crop owner fingerprints, commits and acknowledges this subresult before projecting the terminal crop-plan outcome.

entries.reason: Authoritative successful clean-water consumption and plot irrigation result.
entries.integration_reason: The plot owner reserves the typed outcome before staging the exact fluid mutation, credits plot water, commits/reconciles the same result key, and either commits the supply cooldown stamps or restores plot and fluid state.

entries.reason: Authoritative terminal crop-cycle result with exact sow, harvest, physical input and output provenance.
entries.integration_reason: The crop owner projects the terminal receipt only after physical and ecology commits, requires canonical ledger acknowledgement, and retains owner pending state on failure.

entries.reason: Authoritative per-step building or character damage result with a stable fire operation ID.
entries.integration_reason: A save-owned damage authority reserves the typed outcome before mutation, commits nonlethal building and character damage with rollback on failure, and joins lethal building removal through the seven-participant destructive-drain journal before post-removal finalization.

entries.reason: Authoritative exact physical fuel-loss receipt used by self-heating ignition.
entries.integration_reason: The outcome-aware physical sink prepares and commits the typed fuel-loss outcome with the exact quantity, mass and commit ID, then ignition acknowledges it.

entries.reason: Authoritative processed ignition disposition, including both accepted fire creation and meaningful resolved failures.
entries.integration_reason: The fire runtime reserves the typed ignition result, creates a save-owned pending fire/cause before any physical fuel commit, adopts the exact fuel receipt, commits/reconciles the parent outcome once, and resumes the same result key after retry or restore.

entries.reason: Authoritative suppression result that changes fire intensity or ends the fire and records labor and optional water consumption.
entries.integration_reason: The fire runtime creates a persisted Prepared suppression owner before water, adopts the exact water receipt, applies the fire effect once, commits/reconciles the parent outcome, and retains Prepared/WaterCommitted/Applied pending phases for deterministic retry and restore.

entries.reason: Authoritative exact physical water-consumption receipt for fire suppression.
entries.integration_reason: The outcome-aware reserved physical sink commits the typed water outcome with the suppression operation, lease, quantity and commit ID before acknowledgement.

entries.reason: Pure deterministic resource-multiplier projection with no gameplay mutation or operation identity.
entries.integration_reason: The later crop/production owner that consumes the projected multipliers owns any terminal result.
entries.replacement_authority: Concrete crop or production terminal transaction consuming FiberCropResourceRules output

entries.reason: Authoritative disease-route exposure that mutates population health for one character.
entries.integration_reason: The owner prepares the typed receipt, snapshots health state, records exposure, commits at the resulting health version, and restores/cancels after noncanonical failure.

entries.reason: Follow-up ignition command derived from an already committed work-accident injury, not a second terminal result.
entries.integration_reason: The work accident outcome owns the injury; this receipt only requests a separately classified environmental-fire ignition result when the facility has authored support.
The room owner prepares the typed condition receipt, updates the persisted observation, commits/reconciles, rolls the observation back on failure, and only then publishes the event.

entries.reason: Authoritative room-impression and cleanliness mood application for work, shopping or facility use.
entries.integration_reason: The owner prepares the typed experience receipt, snapshots mood state, applies factors, commits/reconciles and restores mood on noncanonical failure.

entries.reason: Authoritative species-discontent incident with exact actor, species, incident and location data.
entries.integration_reason: The species owner reserves before execution, captures rollback state, writes and commits the typed receipt, restores on failure, and publishes only after durable commit.
